title: Trump administration approves Elon Musk’s plan for datacenters in space
summary_full: The FCC approved 1m Starmind satellites, with the deployment of 100,000 no later than November 2035US federal regulators approved a constellation of datacenters to process data in space on Wednesday, saying that they would “support America’s booming super intelligence economy”.The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) said in a statement that regulators had approved 1m Starmind orbital satellites, or compute modules, built by Elon Musk’s SpaceX. It is the first such authorization in US history. Continue reading...
